title: Bell Schedule Fixture (one pilot)
description:
Schema for each pilot's bell-schedule.json under packages/pilot-fixtures/pilots/<pilot-id>/. Declares the regular-day shift structure plus an optional exam-day variant.

A shift is a contiguous time-range with optional sub-periods. The `scope` field marks whether the shift is academic (attendance + classroom learning) or non-academic (e.g., a boarding-house morning routine). Non-academic shifts may omit `periods` entirely — they're an operational time-range only.

Multi-shift schools are explicitly supported: every pilot may declare 1..N shifts. The C1.7 loader's `shiftProfileForDate(pilot, date)` query picks the right shift for a given calendar day (regular vs exam-day) based on the date's calendar-event metadata.

shifts.description: Regular school-day shifts. At least one. If the pilot operates multiple shifts (e.g., a boarder morning routine and a day academic shift), all go in this array; the loader selects by `scope` at query time.

examDayShifts.description: Optional exam-day variant. When present, the C1.7 loader uses these shifts on dates that have `exam_window` events in the calendar fixture. Same shape as regular shifts.

notes.description: Operator-facing notes (e.g., scope explanations). Not consumed by code.

id.description: Kebab-case slug. Referenced by attendance and class-scheduling code.

scope.description: `academic` = attendance + lessons recorded against periods. `non-academic` = an operational time-range (e.g., boarding routine) that the attendance + bell resolvers will SKIP for academic queries.

startTime.description: 24-hour HH:MM format. Wall-clock time in the pilot's timezone (per metadata.json).

endTime.description: 24-hour HH:MM format. Must be strictly later than `startTime` (enforced at spec time, not at schema time — schema-only check can't compare two fields).

periods.description: Optional sub-periods within the shift. Omit entirely for non-academic shifts whose only meaningful unit is the shift itself.

id.description: Kebab-case slug. Often numeric like `p1`, `p2`, `b1` (exam-day block).

name.description: Optional display name (e.g. 'Period 1', 'Tiffin Break', 'Block A'). Falls back to id.

kind.description: What the period represents. Default treatment is `class` if absent.
